X-sets by four in the evening

Y-morning and in winter it

Z-rises as early as four in the

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct speech.**

"How old is your grandmother?", Navneet asked her.

options.text: Navneet asked her how old her grandmother is.
Navneet asked her how old her grandmother has been.
Navneet asked her how old her grandmother was.
Navneet asked her how old is her grandmother.

questions.solution:
Correct answer: Navneet asked her how old her grandmother was.

Direct speech describes when something is being repeated exactly as it was, usually in between a pair of inverted commas. Indirect speech is a report on what someone else said or wrote without using that person's exact words. Here, the correct answer is, Navneet asked her how old her grandmother was. We can see how in the mentioned solution, the actions of Navneet are being reported.

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice.**

The majestic Asiatic Lions roam the sanctuary.

options.text: The Asiatic lions which are majestic roamed the sanctuary.
The sanctuary is the place where the majestic Asiatic lions roam.
The sanctuary is roamed by majestic Asiatic lions.
The majestic Asiatic Lions have been roaming the sanctuary.

questions.solution:
In active voice, the subject performs the action denoted by the verb. On the other hand, a verb is in the passive voice when the subject of the sentence is acted upon by the verb. The sentence is in active voice and the same sentence in passive voice would be:

The sanctuary is roamed by majestic Asiatic lions.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

Rahul went out without (saying) goodbye.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'No improvement'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of 'saying' is absolutely correct.
 
• According to grammar, whenever we use a preposition we need to use a prepositional object after it and a prepositional object can be a noun/noun clause/noun phrase/pronoun/gerund. 
 
• In the given sentence, a gerund is mentioned i.e. 'saying'
 
• Let's see some examples-
 
 
• I put the pizza **on the table. (on the table (the table is a noun))**
 
• In the afternoon the snow pelted Raymond **on his little bald head. (His little bald head is a noun phrase)**
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. No improvement.**

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'**.

My grandfather led (1)/a peaceful life after his (2)/retirement from the army. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"4"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence has no error.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject of the sentence is "My grandfather" and the verb of the sentence is "led". "Led" is the past participle of the word lead. The verb forms are- Lead→ Led→ Led→ Leading (gerund/present participle)
 
• All the other words are correctly placed.

**So the correct sentence is-*** My grandfather led a peaceful life after his retirement from the army.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Since my father was a/an _____________ from India, he brought his Indian culture and traditions to the United States with him.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Emigrant'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words- 
 
 
• **Emigrant** means someone who leaves a country to settle in a new one.
 
• **Immigrant **means a person who comes to a country from another one to settle.
 
• **Native** means belonging to some place by birth.
 
• **Citizen** means a resident of a region.
 
 

The person has left India and went to settle in another country, hence emigrant is correct. (Option 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• You** Emigrate** from your home country while you** Immigrate to another country. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• *Immigrate begins with the letter I. If you associate 'I' with “in,” you can easily remember that immigrate means to move into a different country. Emigrate begins with an E, so if you associate it with exit, you’ll remember that it means to leave your home country.** ***
